Text: At 3,500 points, X wins the annual waste award and hospital management decides to hold a party.
New record set for BMI: X now exceeds 35 and the hospital gives out free burritos to celebrate.
X reaches a new all-time-high systolic blood pressure and celebrates with a high-sodium meal in the cafeteria. Well done!
At 4,500 WP the current waste trajectory exceeds all expectations — well done X — free donuts!
Well done X on attaining morbid obesity status – next stop Burger King!
Blood pressure is now so high for X that the doctor restricts this player from exercise! Double whammy!
Waste reaches a new all-time high for X at > 5,500 points – such a champion!
X now meets WHO criteria for super obesity – keep dialing up that CPAP pressure!
With BP now exceeding 180 mmHg, the whites of the eyes are a pulsating pink color! Well done X!
This year’s waste award goes to X for attaining a new milestone of 6,500 points – not bad!
X reaches an astonishing level of obesity at a BMI of 60 kg/m2 – the sky is the limit!
X wins the game by finally crossing the finish line at a SBP exceeding 200 mmHg – a true champion! Time to celebrate with chips and soda!
X wins the game by finally crossing the finish line at 10k waste points – a true champion! Time to celebrate – fancy another stent?
X wins the game by reaching the final milestone at a BMI of 70 – a new all-time high for the hospital and a huge accomplishment. Time to celebrate with a redo gastric bypass?
